text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... I lost.
I lost, but—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(This was a wonderful battle!
A true race! Both of us giving our all——)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Gold Ship!
Do you even know why you lost?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If you'd just trained seriously,
you might have won! What were you thinking?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Who cares, it's funny! Right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
So cut that out!
I'm telling you this precisely because you don't get it!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Grating.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Gentil.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "To let minor details distract from anything other than overwhelming power in this situation..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's just like
not having made them understand
the value of power yet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Next time,
with even greater power. For them.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Though you may be a bit too intense
to be called a role model...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, your posture possesses
a strength that makes you want to look up to you.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...I must learn from this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Gentildonna-san right now... Golshi-san up until now...
For my own growth, they're both—)

text_block_list.name: @Hardcore_Stan_564
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi, you lost this time, but
I'll still be rooting for you next time. Don't let it get you down!"

""@Hardcore564Stan
Fenomeno working hard at practice is true justice.
Slacking Golshi is evil.""

text_block_list.name: @Nununu
text_block_list.text:
"There's something about Gold Ship that makes you want to follow her.
I wonder what GⅠ race she's running in next?"

""@nununu
Fenomeno working hard at practice is true justice.
Slacking Golshi is evil.""

text_block_list.name: @Nameless_Lucifer
text_block_list.text: "Uh-oh, some weird fans are popping up."

text_block_list.name: @Car♪rot♪
text_block_list.text:
""@AnonymousLucifer
Aren't they just speaking the truth?""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened the day after the Takarazuka Kinen,
on the way back from our away race.

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: S-Shut up--!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—!?
What is the meaning of this—

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Why would you say it like that!?
Cut it out, that's just mean!

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's just total common sense!
Ev-ery-one is saying it!"

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's a villain! A bad guy!
You're weird for liking someone like that!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: "N-No! You're wrong! Even Golshi would—... U-Uwaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text: H-Hold up, violence is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
HALT RIGHT THEEEERE!!
Stop right where you are, all of youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I am Officer Fenomeno of Tracen Academy.
...May I ask about the situation, sir?"

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fenomeno! Help!
This guy was about to punch me!!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
Because...
...Because—!

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"Because Golshi is weird!
Anyone who likes Golshi is weird too!"

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: No! Golshi is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...This officer will take charge of this matter.
You with the black hat, come with me.

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...*hic*, *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sit the child in the black hat on a bench
and gently stroke their back until they calm down.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
They told everyone that Golshi's a bad person.
So that's why I...

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: It's so frustrating... so frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...Is it weird that I like Gold Ship?

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: Is it bad that I like Gold Ship...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boy.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If Golshi-san is who you look up to,
you can stay just as you are. You're good to go, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
She may not be a role model...
but she isn't some evil that people should be forbidden from admiring.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Do you like Gold Ship-san?

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I see, me too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to what justice truly means,
I still haven't found a definitive answer."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, justice is never meant
to make someone cry, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...It is not a weapon to be brandished
for the sake of hurting others."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I can't let things stay like this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Things must not remain this way...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What cruel irony...!!
Even though I'm treated as an ally of justice, I haven't been able to protect a single thing...!
choice_data_list: Blaming yourself too much is a bad habit of yours.
Beating yourself up too much is a bad habit of yours, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh.
choice_data_list: Then let's discuss what to do next.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――Hah!! There is definitely something I must convey.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —There are people I must tell this to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. Please,
let me enter the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
On the year-end stage that captivates everyone,
I want to convey these feelings!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I want to reach them through my running...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Kh.
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"By then, I will definitely
find my own 'justice' as well."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Not just treated as a slot called "ally of justice."
With one's own justice held firmly in one's heart—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I will stand as an “ally of justice”.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fenomeno and I set our next
goal on the Arima Kinen.
